reviews.title: Note recognition poor
reviews.text: I love the idea and the interface, but tech just always misses the basics - and I’m an engineer in tech…. So I know how these companies work.  The note recognition, probably due to latency constraints, is just not accurate.  I use a Korg monologue xd through Ableton Live and even with clean custom patches, this app just doesn’t perform accurately enough.  For the price point, that’s just stupid given today’s quality.  I’m spending more time trying to dial in the note detection than I am learning.  Want a refund and recommend passing.

reviews.title: App problems, poor support and £114 refund outstanding
reviews.text:
I experienced persistent problems with Simply Piano over several months. Despite repeated complaints, the issues were never satisfactorily resolved.
In September, the company agreed to refund £114. When repayment difficulties arose, I accepted their offer of an Amazon voucher instead. Weeks later, I have received neither.
Customer support has been extremely disappointing, with repetitive automated responses that ignore the history of my complaint. Most recently, I was told refunds take 24–48 hours, despite having waited weeks.
I cannot recommend a subscription service that handles legitimate complaints in this way. I would welcome Simply Piano finally honouring its promise.

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text:
I signed up to this app, wanting the 7 day free trial to see if my son liked it before buying any subscription. The only option for the free trial was to sign up for a years subscription, so I did this with the plan on cancelling my subscription before the 7 days were up and then signing up to pay the monthly subscription as my son was enjoying using it. 
However, after I cancelled my subscription on the 7th day of the free trial, they still took the fee from my account.
I have emailed the company asking for my money to be refunded and to allow me to set up a monthly subscription instead but they have ignored my email.
Such a shame as this app seems to be a brilliant way to learn the piano, however the lack of response and taking my money after I had cancelled the subscription does not feel like they have the best interests of their customers.

reviews.title: Subscription Upgrade easily and support team lacks knowledge
reviews.text:
The team that manages the subscription and the app content should take the experience seriously. I subscribed for individual as I need the app only for the elder child and the younger one  (as he is too young) can have a profile created with contents locked. When clicking on locked content it just prompts asking to go premium and on click of it boom it gets upgraded. How will the kids know how subscription works? The team should protect money related features under passcode as the app will be used by the kid on their own.

Now when I reached the support team, that are saying that I subscribed only for the family plan and never for the individual which is out right wrong. And the support person claims that it cannot be upgraded within the app which is not true at all. So you all need serious attention on how money is accessed through the app especially as the app is also focused on kids. And the support team should be informed of how the app works.

Anyways, I have cancelled the subscription as I lost trust in the way you all are doing business. My son is sad as he really enjoyed the learning but I do not want to do business with someone I cannot trust.
